answers.core: Because it was in the core since practically forever and removing it as of v4.5 was a bad idea. I understand making Linear colour accessible is important, but RAW should've been left in as an option in some manner in the Color Picker so as not to disrupt workflows.
answers.workaround: Presently, the way to work around this is to manually convert RGB triplets from 0-255 into 0.0-1.0 RAW values or vice versa, which is not ideal and not something we had to do back in Godot v4.4.

title: Reimplement "RAW" as a Color Picker Tab
